text: Shortstalk Mushroom is a food consumable sold by the Mushroom Merchant in Neltharion's Lair. On use, it decreases your size and increases your dodge for 1 minute. It is only usable while in Highmountain.

-shire is a word in Common to call a settlement: *Darkshire, Duskwood *Darrowshire, Eastern Plaguelands *Farshire, Borean Tundra *Goldshire, Elwynn Forest *Havenshire, Eastern Plaguelands *Lakeshire, Redridge Mountains *Northshire, Elwynn Forest
__NOTOC__ Shoal-Walker is a deep sea murloc located on the expedition islands.
Short-range Teleportation Units are created with Engineering (1). This item was replaced by Momentum Redistributor Boots.
Shock Barrier is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Shock Barrier.
Shiri is a jungle troll located at Zen'shiri Trading Post in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. She is the co-owner of the trading post, along with Zen'kala.
The Shrine of Remulos is a shrine dedicated to Keeper Remulos, located in western Moonglade. It also houses the night elf Tajarri, who helps young druids along in their quest for the aquatic form.
.]] Shred is a level 5 druid ability. It is a special direct damage Cat Form attack. It deals a large amount of damage and awards 1 combo point.

The Shrine of the Dormant Flame (or the Shrine of Eternal Flame) is a place most holy to all shaman of the Horde. It is accessible via a secret path that spirals around the tallest mountain of the region, just northwest of the Valley of Trials. The top provides a fantastic view of the region, but jumping from the peak is ill-advised. In order to reach the shrine, there is a path starting next to the Southfury River at the southwestern tip of the Southfury Watershed. Telf Joolam is the keeper of the shrine, and wanders alone around it. In prior times, he was responsible for guiding aspiring shaman in the way of taming fire. The brazier at the top would be lit by shamans using the ember of a f
Shroud of Dominion is a cloak with stamina and an increase to attack power and critical strike chance.

The Shrine of Unending Light is the main headquarters of the Aldor and their most holy temple. It is located centrally on the Aldor Rise in Shattrath City and is the home of the faction's high priestess, Ishanah.
Shrine Bauble is contained in Bauble Container in Moonglade.

Shrine of Thaurissan is located inside the Blackrock Depths, accessible from the East Garrison and the Ring of the Law (after the ring's challenge has been beaten). It is the location of Franclorn Forgewright's statue of Thaurissan, and the Monument of Franclorn Forgewright which will yield the Shadowforge Key in return from the iconic hammer Ironfel. The Shrine of Thaurissan leads into Shadowforge City, with the Domicile lying directly across the bridge.
Shriek is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
The following NPCs can be found in the Shrine of Seven Stars.
The Shrine of the Moon is a very small shrine found near the Serenity Falls in the Jade Forest. An Ancient Pandaren Tea Pot is on the table.
Shredded Parchment can be found in Ancient Drakkari Chests in Zul'Drak. It can also be fished from the Hyper-Compressed Ocean.

Shredder Maniac is an achievement earned from looting 12 or more Hardened Thornvines in Gorgrond. One can chop these down using the Mechashredder 5000, an ability granted if you have the Lumber Yard constructed at your outpost.
The Shrine of Shadra is a shrine in the Garden of the Loa dedicated to Shadra in Zuldazar. The loa is attacked by her follower, Yazma, who kills her and steals her power.

The Shrine of Shadows is a secret altar overlooking a cave. Vol'zith the Whisperer is fought here during the Shrine of the Storm instance, while the Restless Cabal are fought here during the Crucible of Storms instance. In the background is a Kul Tiran battleship being corrupted by Tidesages and K'thir, as well as moonlight pouring into the cave from the ceiling. The battleship is the sister ship of The Abyssal Melody that sailed to the Shrine of the Storm during Voices Below.
The Shred of Insanity drops from the bosses in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Shrieking Widow is a banshee encountered by Class Order champions in the Blind Marshlands in Highmountain.
Shredmaw the Voracious is a crocolisk located in Island Expeditions.
Shrieking Flagon is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shoulderpads of Whispering Twilight drop from the Sisters of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Shouldersguards of Raw Power is a quest reward from An Unusual Patron.
Shoulderguards of Unimaginative Magic drops from Humongris in Val'sharah.
The Shrine of Thun'ka stood in honor of Thun'ka the Witherer. If the Herald of Thun'ka's Shackles were destroyed at the shrine, its master would appear.
Shouva is a pandaren located at Zen'shiri Trading Post in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. She tends to the Collector's Cache and the mannequins.

__NOTOC__ Siege Golems are war golem creeps that can be encountered in the Dungeon and Underground tilesets. Despite falling under these tilesets, they can also be found on certain maps with the Cityscape tileset.
__NOTOC__ Shylamiir is a night elf herbalism trainer located in the Lion's Rest of Stormwind City.
Sickly Looking Fish is caught in fresh water in Tirisfal Glades and Silverpine Forest, and in the green slime within the Undercity.
__NOTOC__ Shyn is a tauren flight master located at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

The Shroud of the Nathrezim are shoulderpads that belonged to the dreadlord Balnazzar. They seem to have the same abilities as the Crown of Tyranny, either improves the accuracy and response of its wearer, but Mathias Shaw mentions that these are despicable things, and that he would not even wear them for all the gold of Azeroth.

After the advent of phlogiston-powered boilers, the first vehicles to be built in Lordaeron and Azeroth were weapons of war — dwarven steam tanks, goblin zeppelins, Horde demolishers. Quick on their heels were vehicles to support weapons and troops at war, and the most versatile of these vehicles has proved to be the siege wagon. The siege wagon is a boxy vehicle with ironbound wooden wheels, an armored skin and an expansive interior. The inside compartment of the siege wagon carries materiel and troops to the front lines. Then, upon arriving at an encampment, some wagons become field hospitals or kitchens, while others are used as tinkers’ workshops or officers’ headquarters. However, the t

Sifreldar Village is a village located above Snowblind Terrace, just over the mountains from Brunnhildar Village in the southern area of the Storm Peaks. It is a smaller inhabited by female frost vrykul, known as the Hyldnir. During the war against the Lich King, they raided the goblins at K3 when that outpost was first set up, and took off all the men as captives to work in the mines, leaving the females. Muradin Bronzebeard believes that, based on their similar names, Thorim's wife Sif may have been from this village, or alternatively that the village was named after her.

The Siege of the Sanguine was a major battle between forces of the Undead Scourge and those of the Argent Dawn taking place at Light's Hope Chapel, in the Eastern Plaguelands. It was designed and led by the powerful lich Kirkessen the Zealous, a decorated veteran of countless battles, who reported directly to the Lich King himself. The Siege of the Sanguine was one of the largest organized assaults on Light's Hope Chapel. Despite overwhelming odds, his attack was quickly countered, and his forces suffered enormous damages. Kirkessen himself received a critical blow from Lord Maxwell Tyrosus, and is no longer able to assume a corporeal form.

The Shuddering Spires is an area covered in jagged rock formations like the Jagged Wastes. The area covers much of the middle shelf on the northwestern side of Deepholm. It's here Kor the Immovable is found one with the earth. This area also contains white chalky crystals that the earth elementals can absorb into their skin and purify themselves and become stronger. Rock flayers ravage the weastern area, attacking the Sons of Kor and any other elementals that approach. Basilisks control the eastern area, petrifying any Stone Bats that fly into their territory.
Siamat, Lord of the South Wind, is the final boss in the Lost City of the Tol'vir. To get to Siamat, all the previous bosses must be killed first.

Shu'ma is one of three massive servants of the Old Gods who surface in the Dragonblight in the Dragon Soul raid, the other two being Go'rath and the Maw of Destruction. Within the Maw of Shu'ma, the faceless one Yor'sahj binds the blood of Shu'ma to his will, granting him power. Shu'ma ceases to attack upon the death of Yor'sahj.
Siege of Niuzao Temple is a dungeon in World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria, set on one of the western islands of the Townlong Steppes.
Shuffle is a Brewmaster monk ability, available at level 82.
__NOTOC__ Shrouded Cetaceans are whale sharks found swimming south of the big islands in Krasarang Wilds.
__NOTOC__ Shrouded Carcharodons are great white sharks found swimming south of the big islands in Krasarang Wilds.

The siege of Grommashar was the final assault on the 's base of operations within , with the principal objective to dispose of Garrosh Hellscream, former warchief of the Horde, fugitive from the prime timeline as well as the latest Warlord of the Warsong clan in Draenor. The Azerothian coalition laid siege to the city, ultimately drawing Garrosh from hiding and culminated in a duel between Garrosh and Thrall at the Stones of Prophecy, future site of Garadar, with Thrall as the victor.

Siegebrul Olgrul is the master of worms for the Mightstone drogbar attacking Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain. Navarrogg describes him as a sadistic brute who torments all who serve him, saying that "There are evil drogbar, and there is this foul monster". Navarrogg also scoffs at Olgrul's title of "Siegebrul", saying that there was no need for such titles before the war.
__NOTOC__ Siegemaster Aedrin is a nightborne located in Moon Guard Stronghold in Suramar.

Siege towers are siege vehicles used by the Alliance. Siege towers were used by the Sons of Lothar during the battles in Hellfire Peninsula during the invasion of Draenor. One is the entrance to Blood Furnace. Siege towers were also used by the modern Alliance during the time of the Battle for Lordaeron. Several were used in the siege of Capital City against the defending Horde forces. These constructs were several stories tall, and armed with multiple cannons and a top-mounted trebuchet that could launch flaming projectiles over fortifications. Two were used to defend Stromgarde Keep during the Battle for Stromgarde. One War Machine was sent by the Horde to Drustvar.
The Shutterbug is an automatron located next to Arielle Snapflash near Olivia's Pond in Stormwind City.

The Sight is an ability which allows one to see prophetic visions of the future. Prophet Velen's gift of Sight warned him of the dangers of joining Sargeras. Granted a vision by a naaru called K'ure, Velen led his people off Argus. The sight to visions can also be induced by an extract made by alchemists. Several Zandalari trolls have the Sight as well. Known examples are Zul and Vol'jamba, though The Dark Prophet Zul says Zul is simply "one of" the dark prophets, implying the existence of more than one or two dark prophets.
The Siege of Capital City was the beginning of the end of the Horde during the Second War.

The Shudderwock is an unknown creature featured in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone. The earliest mentions of this bizarre entity were recorded in nonsensical children's rhymes, and thus initial reports of the Shudderwock in the woods were dismissed as the hysterical prattle of an unhinged mind. The poor soul was indeed unhinged, but the Shudderwock lurking in the Witchwood is nonetheless terrifyingly real. Much like Baku the Mooneater, Shudderwock is unique to the Witchwood and seems to exist somewhere on the edge of reality, defying easy description as well as physical and arcane laws. In fact, it is unclear if the Shudderwock is "real" in the way that one generally uses the wor
The Siege Engine Controllers were sold for by Lieutenant Elda during Island Expeditions. It summoned an Expedition Siege Engine.
Sickly Cougars are mountain lions located in Mulgore in the Emerald Nightmare.

__NOTOC__ Siegeotron is a dwarven golem located in a small camp on the Blood Coast in Nazmir while the Faction Assault on Nazmir world quest Siegeotron (quest) is available. It is initially dormant and surrounded by four Dark Iron Rune Keepers who are channeling magic into it. Once the Rune Keepers are killed, Siegeotron awakens and becomes attackable.

Shugshul the Flesh Gorger is a fleshbeast located at Neferset City in Uldum. It has a chance to be spawned alongside two other rare elites (from a total pool of six) after enough players have completed the available summoning events in the area.
Sick Riverbeast is a riverbeast located in the Lair of Xak'lar in Nazmir. Blood Priest Xak'lar is channeling blood magic into it.

__NOTOC__ The Sight-O-Matic 3000 is a telescope located among the mountains directly east of Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate. Binkie Brightgear has set it up to spy on the gate. Looking through it will offer a closer look at Aldur'thar, revealing that the area is crawling with members of the Cult of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ Shuk'shuguun the Subjugator is a n'raqi located in Island Expeditions.

Siege Artillery are ballistae located in Maldraxxus. versions are used by the traitor houses to attack the Bleak Redoubt while the world quest Better Off Dead is available, and players have to destroy them by planting Necrotic Charges next to them. versions affiliated with the Undying Army are seen laying siege to the southern walls of the House of Rituals during The Third Fall of Kel'Thuzad.
Siegebreaker's Stand is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shrouded Hero: Shadowlands Season 4 is a feat of strength achievement earned by ending Shadowlands Mythic+ Season 4 with a Mythic+ Rating in the top 0.1% for your faction.
Siennagosa is a dracthyr located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus. Only scribes with 25 points in Dragon Isles inscription may interact with her to obtain the Counterfeit Darkmoon Deck.

The Shrouded Coast is the northwestern shore of the Forbidden Reach mainland. The area is bordered by Skyward Watch just offshore to the north, the Caldera of the Menders across the pass to the south, and Winglord's Perch far offshore to the west. The rare Reisa the Drowned spawns in a small cave at on the beach, and Ookbeard spawns at on a small island not far from his pirate ship. Additionally Ishyra, the Maiden of Discernment, keeps a lookout at atop the Skyward Watch just offshore. The "Caldera Coaster" dragonriding race also starts at Skyward Watch. The Irontide Raiders use the coast as a beachhead, with deadshots, hozen, scallywags pushing inland. Animated reef elementals and vorquin a

The Siege Creche is a large building stuffed inside the Stormsunder Mountain of Stormsunder Crater. The Primalists control the creche, and the rare proto-dragon Volcanakk spawns inside. Veteran Cauterizers, Veteran Flameguards, and Primal Blazes all hold the area.

The Silithus Field Duty quest collection was added in patch 1.9 to the Silithus area. They were designed to provide casual players with the ability to achieve raid-level rewards, and require the character be a minimum of level 60. The basic format of the Silithus Field Duty quests involves completing a boss encounter with the help of several NPCs. After this boss is defeated, you are offered a choice of combat, tactical, or logistic assignments. When you complete your assignments, you are rewarded with a relevant badge. You can save these badges and turn them in for various items or given to Windcaller Kaldon in Cenarion Hold for a reputation bonus. The Silithus Field Duty quest chain is onl

The silithid lights can be found in every hive or underground cave of the silithid. They are able to produce light to illuminate the dark caves. These silithid lights could be thought of as larvae of the silithid considering these creatures are insect-like in their being. Just as a firefly produces a sort of glow, these youngling silithid may be the primary source of light in their deep caverns. The mantid have similar mantis-creatures in the Heart of Fear.

Silithid colossi are huge creatures with brutal strength. In each of the three hives of Silithus sleeps one, awaiting battle. With their four legs, two scythe-like arms, gouging horns, and large two-part bodies, they seem similar to the kunchong of the Mantid and the spiderlords of Azjol-Nerub, hinting at a shared origin. Their massive thorax-heads seem to contain a giant brain, which can become exposed. After The Scarab Gong was rung and the ancient Gates of Ahn'Qiraj opened, the horrors of the silithid and their qiraji masters were revealed. Massive qiraji resonating crystals broke through the earthen crust of Kalimdor and the colossi of the hives in Silithus emerged from their cocoons ben

Silithid Creepers are silithid were found in the southern part of the Barrens. These silithid are very aggressive, but not all that strong. They had a special ability; they could lay a level 20-21 Silithid Creeper Egg which hatched into a level 20-21 Silithid Grub.
The Signet of the Violet Tower is an ring available to both factions as a quest reward. The combination of stamina, intellect, spell power and MP5 on this ring make it a nice one for casters.
The Signet of the Kirin Tor is sold by in Dalaran for . It can cost as low as at reputation with Kirin Tor. Using it teleports the adventurer to Dalaran in Northrend.

Sik'vess is the southwestern kypari tree in Townlong Steppes. The Sha of Hatred has made it's way here after destroying Hatred's Vice and the Dusklight Hollow. Three elite mantid hold parts of a crystal that will open the door into the Sik'vess Lair on the tree's northeast side: Korvexxis, Serevex, and Rothek. From there, the Sha of Hatred awaits. Sik'vess's territory is bordered clockwise from the north by the Shado-Pan Garrison, Rensai's Watchpost, the Farwatch Overlook, the Widening Deep, and the Hollowed Out Tree. File:Taoshi and Korvexxis.jpg|Taoshi and Korvexxis File:Lao-Chin and Serevex.jpg|Lao-Chin and Serevex File:Nurong and Rothek.jpg|Nurong and Rothek
Silithian Hatchlings are spiders found in Stonetalon Mountains. They are spawn during the fight with Queen Silith.
Sik'thik Drones are mantid found flying in packs of three at Sik'vess in the Townlong Steppes.

Sigil of Power drops from all raid boss encounters as personal loot in Mogu'shan Vaults, Heart of Fear, Terrace of the Endless Spring, Throne of Thunder or the eight first bosses in Siege of Orgrimmar. The sigils will drop in all four raid modes: Raid Finder, Flexible (for Siege of Orgrimmar), 10/25-player Normal, and 10/25-player Heroic. The chance for the item to drop is one attempt per eligible boss, per week across all difficulties, and the chance for the item to drop is the same regardless of difficulty mode. Lei Shen and the Sha of Pride have a 100% drop rate.
Silent Tosi is a pandaren who briefly appears in Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.
Sik'thik Flyers are mantid located at the Rear Staging Area in the Siege of Niuzao Temple.
Sigil of Silence is a Vengeance demon hunter ability. It is an exclusive choice node with Roaring Fire.
Signets of Orgrimmar were sold for by Provisioner Burg during Island Expeditions.
Signet of Shifting Magics drops from Black Iron Veteran and Drakonid Monstrosity in Upper Blackrock Spire.
Sigrid the Shroud-Weaver is a kvaldir who can be encountered during Island Expeditions. She also has a chance to appear in Quarters of the Damned in the Naglfar during the expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Signilda Hardforge is a dwarf warrior trainer located in the Training Hall in Stormwind City.
Sign of the Destroyer is a buff which is on max level player's characters during the Cataclysm Timewalking event, which lasts one week.
Silent Spirit is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Signet of the Watcher's Guile is a quest reward from The Shattered Watcher.
The Sigil of Warding drops from Maut in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Sigil of Scutes is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Sigil of Skoldus is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Silent Elysian Bell is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Signet of Tormented Kings is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Silent Soulstalker is a soul seeker located on the eastern edge of the Vault of Secrets in southern Korthia. One of the Conquering Korthia-required vignettes, players must be in The Rift to interact with the soul seeker. To enter the rift, reach (honored) with the Archivists' Codex, then purchase a Repaired Riftkey and use it on a Rift Portal on the Vault of Secrets island. The soulstalker also drops ~60x Relic Fragment, ~10-11x uncommon-quality anima items (50-55 anima), Rift-Touched Bindings, and Silent Soulstalker Sabatons, and is worth 5% progress toward Shaping Fate.
Signet of Bolstering is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Signet of Collapsing Stars is dropped by So'leah in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Signet of the Dragonflights is contained in Dracthyr Supply Chest.

Silk is a type of fiber used in making textiles, and generally produced by spiders and moth larvae. The Mok'nathal of the Blade's Edge Mountains harvest silk from the cocoons of wild moth larvae. The silk farms of Pandaria, such as the ancient and respected Silken Fields, raise their own silkworms for silk production. High-ranking members of the Defias Brotherhood wear silk bandanas to signify their rank; other members' bandanas are made from materials like linen instead. In the Shadowlands, the night fae of Ardenweald gather silk from silkstriders. Their main production hub is the Gossamer Cliffs.

Silver is found in silver veins and can be smelted into silver bars. Mining silver veins requires a Classic mining skill of at least 75. Silver veins will sometimes but rarely spawn instead of a tin vein, so silver is found in the same areas as tin. Silver veins can also produce gems and Coarse Stone. It is possible that silver is effective for slaying monsters. To counter Drust magic, the Order of Embers used weapons of silver.
Silver Hakkari Bijou is a small token of power from the mobs in Zul'Gurub.
Silvered Bronze Gauntlets are standard gloves crafted by blacksmiths that will give a bonus to strength, stamina, and critical rating.
Shooting a player character with a Silver Shafted Arrow creates a Peddlefeet winged, flying goblin companion for that player.
The Silvermoon Hawkstrider can be purchased for from at the Argent Tournament.
Silvermoon Commendation Badges are sold by at the Sunreaver Pavilion of the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown for .
Five Silvermoon Apprentices stand ready to take instructions from Instructor Antheol at Stillwhisper Pond in the blood elf starting zone of Eversong Woods.

__NOTOC__ Silvermoon Delegation Guardians are found within Grommash Hold, in front of Ambassador Dawnsinger and flanking Master Pyreanor and Tyelis. They appear to be part of the blood elf delegation, their Forsaken counterparts just opposite them. They also appeared in the funeral ceremony for Vol'jin at the Dranosh'ar Blockade.
The Silken Pillow is the inn for the city of Elodor in . The place is run by Nethene. Elodor Earthworkers can be seen moving goods to and from the inn.
The Silver-Lined Arrow is found at the back of Nhallish's area in the Heroic version of the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds. It is speculated to have belonged to Alleria Windrunner.

__NOTOC__ Silver Hand Knights located in the Sanctum of Light, inside the Greyfang Enclave and briefly at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran. They are later present in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore. They are also in the Stirring in the Shadows scenario. Ultimately, they can be seen on the Vindicaar.
The Silver Arachnodrone is a mechanical spider found on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh. Hunters may tame it, after using an Electrified Key and bringing it below 30% hp.

Silver Hand Templar are paladins located in the Sanctum of Light. They briefly appeared after the completion of Blessing of the Order (quest). They serve as troops accompanying the Class Hall champions.

__NOTOC__ Silvermoon Defenders are high elves located at the Dead Scar of Ghostlands during the The First to Fall. They also appear at the Dead Scar near the East Sanctum of Eversong Woods during The Day Hope Died. Ultimately, they appear at the Sunwell during The Fall of the Sunwell.
Silvermoon Ballista is a ballista located at the Dead Scar near the East Sanctum of Eversong Woods during The Day Hope Died.
Silver Covenant Mages are high elves located in the Wizard's Sanctum of Stormwind City. They maintain a portal to Dalaran in Northrend.
Silver Jasmine is located in Suramar City during The Old Fashioned Way.
Silvermoon Adventurers are blood elves located in Orgrimmar. During the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar, they were waiting in a queue in front of the gate.
The Silksand Shoulder Pads are a continent drop in Kalimdor.

Silkstrider Grubs are silkstrider larvae located in the exterior of Ardenweald's Heart of the Forest, where they roam near Betsy, and in the Gossamer Cliffs, where they hatch from destroyed Silkstrider Cocoons. In Torghast, the silkstrider Ella can beckon Night Fae players to help her find a lost Silkstrider Grub as the objective of Assist Ella With ?. The Heart of the Forest version can be petted.

The Silky Shimmermoth is sold by Master Clerk Salorn at Star Lake Amphitheater in Ardenweald for . Players must have defeated all summoned enemies at the amphitheater, earning the achievement Ardenweald's a Stage, before Salorn will sell the mount.
Silvermoon Champions are blood elves located at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown during the Scourge assault in Death Rising.
The Silver Gearglider was a flying disc that was never made available. It would likely have been obtained in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.

Silver Hand Betrayers are human paladins located in the Culling of Stratholme. In the corrupted memories of Uther the Lightbringer, they are followers of Arthas Menethil who torched the city on his orders when he started his purge.
Silk Shooter is located in Gossamer Cliffs in Ardenweald. Interacting with it gives the following ability: *

Silkstriders (also written silk striders) are large, silk-producing beasts native to Ardenweald. They are domesticated by the night fae, who use their silk to craft music instruments, weapons, and tools. Despite its gossamer appearance, silkstrider thread possesses great tensile strength, allowing it to be used as a bowstring for war and merriment alike. For this reason, the animals are vital to Ardenweald; more important than almost anyone knows. Silkstriders are very delicate creatures and will not spin silk if they become stressed or frightened, so the night fae play music for them to keep them calm and happy. When content, they dance gracefully and make humming or chirping noises. The an

The Silver Scale is a dragon scale forged of purest silver in Tyrhold and gifted to the Dragon Aspects by Keeper Tyr. The Aspects kept it in the vaults of Valdrakken during their absence. Though they had no idea the purpose of this memento, it has always been a symbol of unity and friendship to them. In their absence, the scale changed and now pulsed with a potent magic, with Alexstrasza guessing it was due to the dragons' return to the Dragon Isles. The Dragon Queen summoned it in the Seat of the Aspects to present it to the adventurer and asked them to take the scale and investigate its mysteries with Watcher Koranos.
Silly Hat is provided by Lady Moonberry to use on Dreaming Druids in Central Encampment for Hatted Hibernation.

Silverpine Forest, or simply Silverpine, is a vast, ancient wood that runs along Lordaeron's rugged western coast. The land ranges from fairly flat to hilly, and is nestled among even taller mountains. The forest is eerily silent save for the occasional unnatural howling echoing among the trees. Mossy overhangs shiver in the cold breeze, and the trees are all sickly or dying. Dilapidated farmsteads and abandoned mines dot the land, home now to the darker denizens of the woods. This woodland is haunted and wild, characterized by its tall, silver-barked pines towering over grassy knolls. The Alliance once protected Silverpine Forest when it was verdant and lively. Now the place is shrouded in

Silverwing Outpost is located in south-central Ashenvale, north of the border with the Barrens and southwest of Splintertree Post. It is the eastern Alliance bastion of defense against the Horde, and it is located on the Horde side of the Falfarren River. Because of this, the sentinels posted there have to fight back constant attacks from the nearby orcs, who are unrelenting in their goal of ridding the woods of the Silverwings once and for all. Its leader is Duriel Moonfire. After the Cataclysm, Garrosh Hellscream led the Horde in besieging the outpost. With the outpost's fortifications falling to his tactics, his army was able to assault the Silverwing Sentinels and drive away any who surv

Sin'Dall is a legendary female tiger found in Northern Stranglethorn. She is spoken of in legend, which describes an elusive tigress, so powerful that she dwarfs even the elder males. The hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition have hunted for her without success, and many of them have fallen prey to her raking claws, their bodies now decaying at the foot of her hill. Ajeck Rouack wants her paw. Sin'Dall can be found on a small hill north of Grom'gol Base Camp, and southwest of Nesingwary's Expedition.
Simone Cantrellis a night elf found near Ravenholdt Manor in the Alterac Mountains. Killing Simone causes an increase of Syndicate reputation and a decrease of Ravenholdt reputation.
__NOTOC__ Silvershell Leggings is a pair of Level 50 quality Plate Leggings that improve Strength, Stamina and Critical Strike.

The figure of Sindweller stands partially within the shadows, moving easily among them. As the light hits him, glimpses can be seen of a slender frame, delicate features, long hair bound back in a tight braid, and a glittering black blade. Even as the shadows return, however, the cloth bound across the eyes, and the hint of smoke behind them, can be seen, as if the orbs there still burned from the fire that destroyed them. Sindweller uses his stealth to full advantage. His light armor makes him more maneuverable than most opponents, and he darts in to attack then retreats into the shadows. Immolation and mana burn not only deal damage but distract foes from their own battle plans, making it

The "silverwolf elf", is a famous half-elf in their race's legends. He is said to be the first half-elf child ever abandoned by the elves. Wolves found him in the wilderness and raised him, and he became the greatest warrior in Azeroth. That is until he caught sight of a human city and was enamored by it. The humans greeted him, then they waylaid him, blinded him, and forced him to row a galley ship for close to one hundred and fifty years before he finally died at the oars.

Silvermoon Robes drop from Fenissa the Assassin in Bloodmyst Isle. It is a vanity item, notable for its roleplaying value amongst the Blood Elf playerbase and as such, when sold in the neutral Auction House, commonly fetches high prices upwards of 30 gold. While it isn't as hard to farm as the Blood Elf Bandit Mask, it's nonetheless very hard to get when playing as Horde because of the location of the Bloodmyst Isle.
__NOTOC__ Silvery Pigment is commonly obtained from Milling: * Golden Sansam * Dreamfoil * Mountain Silversage * Sorrowmoss * Icecap

Sindragosa's Fall is the boneyard where the Lich King raised Sindragosa, the frost-queen, as seen in the Wrath of the Lich King cinematic trailer (which can be found [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3SGHMTBG3tQ here]). During the War of the Ancients, the blue dragonflight was decimated; and many of the dragons fell to ground that later became covered by the Icecrown Glacier. Among them, Malygos's consort Sindragosa died here as she desperately sought to reach the Dragonblight — the place where dragons instinctively travel to die. Thousands of years later, Arthas Menethil, the Lich King, awoke from his long dormancy and journeyed to Sindragosa's Fall, where he raised Sindragosa into undeath as

The Silvermoon Messenger is a blood elf courier sent by Lor'themar Theron to the Ghostlands. The messenger conveys the Regent Lord's annoyance at Vereesa Windrunner's presence in Quel'Thalas, and learns that ranger-general Halduron Brightwing had personally requested it. The messenger notes that Halduron had no right to go against Lor'themar's orders, though Halduron asserts his authority over such matters as ranger-general.
Silvermoon Writs of Commendation are sold by Zen'Vorka at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front for .
Sinan the Dreamer is a pandaren and member of the Golden Lotus. She appears to have the ability of astral projection, her spirit giving out quests inside Mogu'shan Palace.
__NOTOC__ Silvermoon Runeseekers are blood elves located in various parts of Pandaria.

__NOTOC__ Silvermoon Spellbreakers are blood elves located in and around the Dawnseeker Promontory, the Sunreaver base camp on the Isle of Thunder. Their appearance marks the first time the Spellbreaker unit has appeared in World of Warcraft.

__NOTOC__ Silvermoon Scholars are blood elves who have journeyed to Telogrus Rift in order to better study the Void. With the birth of the void elves who established themselves on Telogrus, other elves have traveled to the Rift in search of forbidden knowledge, including high elf wayfarers.
Silvermoon Squeeze, while presumably made for Kirin Tor Tavern Crawl, was never made available.

The Silverscale Minnow is a bait item that can be caught while the Moosehorn Hook is applied. The hook can be fished from open water in Stormheim and from Fevers of Stormrays; using it allows the angler to catch a Minnow, which can in turn be applied as bait to catch Thundering Stormrays. If this item is used after having obtained the Underlight Angler, one will instead catch the Thundering Stormray (artifact power).
Silvermoon Sorcerers are blood elves located in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Silvermoon Warcasters are blood elves located in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Silvermoon Soldiers are blood elves who patrol Orgrimmar with Lady Liadrin after the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar.
The Sinfall Surface Flyer is a dredbat located in Sinfall in Revendreth.
Silvermoon Sorceresses are blood elf War Campaign troop units.
Sinew-Sewn Tassels is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Simple Glasses are cosmetic eyeglasses in the head slot sold for by Finn in outside the Barber Shop in the Trade District of Stormwind City or Ca'nees in the Barber Shop of Orgrimmar.
Sinful Gladiator's Badge of Ferocity is sold by Zo'sorg in Oribos for .
Sinful Aspirant's Badge of Ferocity is sold by Purveyor Zo'kuul in Oribos for .
Sinful Delight is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Sinful Delight.

__NOTOC__ Sinfall Defenders are venthyr located in multiple locations, including Revendreth, the Ember Court, Sanguine Depths, and later briefly in Ardenweald during The Battle of Ardenweald. They wield a variety of weapons, such as rapiers, daggers, and crossbows.
Sinfall Flyers are dredbats located in Sanguine Depths and Halls of Atonement.
Sinfall Screecher Cage is a cage found in the Maw during a Kyrian Assault. Destroying the attached Chain of Domination will release the cage to the ground.

Sinstralis of the Pain was a demonic gladiator, along two other demons, Destroyer Zardikar and Talnivarr the Sleeper. She was accompanied by her army of loyal voidwalkers. The trio resided in the Outland Arena waiting for challengers. After the third war the beastmaster Rexxar, Cairne Bloodhoof, Rokhan and Chen Stormstout came across a portal to the arena while traveling through the Barrens. They fought Sinstralis of the Pain in order to gain access to her library of agility tomes.
Sir Malory Wheeler is a Forsaken Arathi Basin battlemaster located in the Royal Quarter in the Undercity during the Call to Arms: Arathi Basin.

Sir Zeliek was one of the Four Horsemen of Naxxramas. He was a paladin in life, so strong in his faith, that even in undeath the power of the Light still heeded his call, smiting his foes in battle. Though his body was forced to obey Kel'Thuzad's commands, Sir Zeliek managed to retain his sanity and morals despite his corruption. This makes him a tragic character, forced to slay what he once held dear in his heart against his will.
__NOTOC__ Singed Basilisks are basilisks found in the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains.

The Sinner's Folly, captained by Captain Shely, was the flagship of High General Abbendis during the flight from the Scarlet Enclave. It sits moored to the south of New Hearthglen in the Dragonblight. It could also be seen in King's Harbor in the Scarlet Enclave by death knight adventurers in the first two phases of their starting experience. Horde players from Venomspite, seeking to sabotage the Scarlet Onslaught's war effort, are tasked with boarding the Sinner's Folly, setting fire to the sails, killing its captain, and stealing its rutters, so the Onslaught would not be able to escape by sea.
The Singing Grove is a place where nature grows in the Nexus. Treants and Ancients roam alongside Dryads through the magical grove. Ormorok the Tree-Shaper can be found towards the back of the grove.
Siphon Anima is an ability used by Son of Animus during a Pet Battle.
Sinnea Starsong was a night elf found at the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City, during the Lunar Festival.
The Sinister Shadows drops from Cho'gall in the Bastion of Twilight. This item only drops for vulpera adventurers and will add a new cyclable ability to the Bag of Tricks (racial) racial.

Sinister Gladiator: Battle for Azeroth Season 2 is a feat of strength achievement earned by ending Battle for Azeroth PvP Season 2 in the top 0.1% of the 3v3 arena ladder (requiring 150 games won on your current faction).

Sinister Gladiator's Proto-Drake is an achievement reward from Gladiator: Battle for Azeroth Season 2. Obtaining this mount also awards the Feat of Strength Sinister Gladiator's Proto-Drake (achievement).

Siphoned Malice is a conduit for mages in the Venthyr covenant. It drops from the following bosses: *The Lord Chamberlain in the Halls of Atonement *Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria *The Prototype Pantheon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones *Valinor in Bastion *Mortanis in Maldraxxus *Oranomonos the Everbranching in Ardenweald *Nurgash Muckformed in Revendreth. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthening the Bond (Venthyr).
The Sinful Gladiator's Soul Eater is a reward from Gladiator: Shadowlands Season 1. Obtaining this mount also awards the Feat of Strength Sinful Gladiator's Soul Eater (achievement).

Sinful Gladiator: Shadowlands Season 1 is a feat of strength achievement earned by ending Shadowlands PvP Season 1 in the top 0.1% of the 3v3 arena ladder (requiring 150 games won on your current faction).
Sinister Soulcarvers are goblins and gnomes located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Huddled Carvings is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Sinstone Swingers is a group of performers. They are briefly seen in the Broker's Den during Report to Oribos. Their members consist of: *Dirtwhistle *Evaile *Hips *Verethian *Vilt
Sinful Surge is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Sinful Surge.
Sinful Hysteria is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Sinful Hysteria.
Sinister Teachings is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Sinister Teachings.
Siphon Storm is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Siphoning Storm.

Sir Sweetthistle is a faerie located at Claw's Edge in Ardenweald. He offers a buff when Claw's Edge is empowered through the use of the Anima Conductor in the Heart of the Forest. His buff is mutually exclusive with that of Buoruon and Ka'rolel.
Siphoning Crystal was seemingly planned as an objective of In Deep. They would be used on Ley Line Accumulators, which are presently an objective of Disruption of Power.
Singe is a black whelp found in Stonewatch Keep in the Redridge Mountains. Singe was Gath'Ilzogg's companion.

Skeletal horses are the remains of horses that have succumbed to the Lich King's plague. They have since been raised from the dead by the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity and are now used as mounts by the Forsaken. The Forsaken believe that without a purpose, even beasts of burden suffer in undeath. At least some skeletal horses have been known to try to graze as they did in life, oblivious to the fact that the grass simply falls back to the earth when they attempt to chew it.
Sister Riven is a rare harpy found in east of the Charred Vale in Stonetalon Mountains.
Sisters Sorcerous was a reagent shop found in Dalaran. It existed until the city moved to the Broken Isles where it was taken over by the Threads of Fate clothing shop.
This item is crafted with Inscription, via the Darkmoon Card of the North recipe.

:"The strength of the Argent Crusade lies in our unwavering faith in the Light and in each other." Sister Colleen Tulley cares for the crusaders in Argent Vanguard by serving them chicken soup. She was present during Death Rising.
The small seam engines that power these wheeled boots allow the wearer to move at high speeds over clear terrain.
Skeezie is a goblin flight master located at Bogpaddle in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Sira Moonwarden is an important night elven warden. When Maiev Shadowsong went missing during the third invasion of the Burning Legion, she became the interim leader of the Wardens. During the Fourth War, she was killed by the Forsaken and raised as a Dark Warden in service of Sylvanas Windrunner. Apparently resenting Maiev deeply for what she perceived as her having abandoned them, saddling Sira with the burden of leadership, a perceived abandonment by Elune, and feeling the despair of death, she is now dedicated to killing her former leader and serving the Banshee Queen. She was tasked by Sylvanas Windrunner with killing the loa of death Bwonsamdi but ultimately failed, was captured by the

Skeletal Archers were level 1 creeps encountered in and around the town of Brill. They were paired with the slightly tougher Skeleton Warriors. Unlike there melee counterparts, they were not marked as undead, and could not be damaged with Arthas' Holy Light ability.
Skeletal Mount can be found standing next to the wagon on the mountain ridge in southeastern Coldarra in the Borean Tundra.

Sirius Ebonwing is a blood elf demon hunter who can be found in various places on Mardum during the demon hunter starting experience. He later traveled with Cassiel Nightthorn, Asha Ravensong and Arduen Soulblade in pursuit of a dreadlord. While the group was scouting the area of Black Rook Hold, they were captured. When the adventurer frees Sirius, it is already too late: The blood elf is consumed by the power of the fel energy pervading Black Rook Hold and goes mad, attacking the adventurer. This leaves no choice but to slay him.
Skawn is the roc companion of Agna the Fowl, found atop Windripper Peak in Highmountain while the World Quest Retake the Skyhorn is available.
Sira's Extra Cloak is a toy rarely looted from the Warden's Supply Kit. The drop rate is about 3%. The Sira in question is most certainly Sira Moonwarden.
__NOTOC__ Skara is a deceased Lightforged draenei, her body is located at the Shattered Fields on Krokuun. In-game, she is referred to as the Lightforged Courier.

Sirens are dangerous creatures native to the coasts of Kul Tiras, mainly Tiragarde Sound. They have the upper bodies of female humanoids, with wings in place of arms and snake- or fish-like lower bodies, and possess magical voices with which they can enslave other beings and lure ships into shipwrecks. They are considered a plague on the seas and a danger to all seafarers.
Animal skeletons can be reanimated as undead beasts through dark magic.
Siren's School for Spells is a school located in the Siren's Vigil of Suramar City in Suramar.
Sixteen-Servo-Actuator is contained in Bondo's Strongbox (opened by Strongbox Key) on Mechagon Island.
Skeleton Guardians are skeletons who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.

Sire Denathrius is the final boss of Castle Nathria. The Master of Revendreth has fallen prey to the very sins he was meant to excise from others, now seeking to rule the realms. As the one responsible for the severe anima drought throughout the Shadowlands, and one of The Jailer's foremost allies, Denathrius must be overthrown if the Covenants are to prevail against the Jailer. The battle against Denathrius is a very long one which consists of 3 different phases. Phase 1 revolves around the raid managing their Burden of Sin stacks and avoiding Denathrius' sneak attacks. Phase 2 involves battling Denathrius, his living sword Remornia, and his loyal followers, while using the room's teleporta
The Sister of Anguish is a mogu ghost located in Island Expeditions.
Six-League Pack is located on a floating island south of Darkhaven in Revendreth, or from Buried Caches unearthed by Toothpick.
Sister Anana is a dryad located in the Verdant Wilds during Island Expeditions.
Skeletal Misthounds are skeletal hounds located in the Blind Marshlands in Highmountain.
__NOTOC__ Skavis Nightstalker is a worgen located in Island Expeditions.

__NOTOC__ Sister Chelicerae is a rare elite spider located within a small cave at the Bony Spindles in Maldraxxus. The Intricate Webbing protecting the entrance has to be destroyed in order to lure her out, but beware the waves of her children that appear to defend it.

Skeleton Bulwarks are unattackable skeletons encountered during The Third Fall of Kel'Thuzad / The Medallion of Dominion. A row of them guard the top of the stairs leading up to Baroness Ninadar early in the assault but are destroyed by the Prime Steelskins accompanying the player. During the battle with Kel'Thuzad in Exoramas, groups of Skeleton Bulwarks are stationed in each of Exoramas' four corners; Draven, Kael'thas, Balmedar, Vashj, Draka, and Alexandros battle them while the player fights the Arch-Lich.
Six of Putrescence is a reagent for Darkmoon Deck: Putrescence.
Six of the Indomitable is a reagent for the Darkmoon Deck: Indomitable.
Sister Dedarkia is a Highmountain tauren located at the Skyway in Orgrimmar.
Skinner Jamani was a jungle troll located in the Valley of Spirits in the orcish city of Orgrimmar.
Skul's Cold Embrace is a level 48 quality Plate Chest that improves Strength, Stamina and Dodge.
Skulking Row is the westernmost path through the Ruins of Silvermoon in Eversong Woods.

The Sketh'lon Base Camp is located southeast of the Wildhammer Stronghold in southwestern Shadowmoon Valley. It is filled with the roaming ghosts of the arakkoan members of the Dark Conclave who used to live here.

Skra'gath is a mini-boss of the Ring of Blood in Nagrand. Skra'gath does an AoE knockback spell-interrupt and has a chance to gain health when damaging enemies in melee. Resistant to the first school of magic used against him.

Skorn (written as Skörn on the world map) is a large vrykul fortress in the northern Howling Fjord. It is the home of the Winterskorn clan, which sits atop a large hill with a commanding view of the surrounding countryside, though the Winterskorn prefer throwing frostbolts from their watchtowers rather than manning harpoon guns like the Dragonflayer clan. At the time of the war against the Lich King, the Winterskorn were awakened by the Scourge at the behest of the Lich King himself. They were dangerous enough that Westguard Keep sent Alliance adventurers to partially destroy the village by bombarding its towers. After the war against the Jailer, Muradin Bronzebeard reported that the damage
Sketh'lon Feathers can be found north of Eclipse Point in Shadowmoon Valley.

The Skettis Outcasts, possibly known as the Skettis Exiles, are a faction of arakkoa that broke off from Skettis. They used to be a faction within Skettis, but their leader Kirrik had a dream from A'dal which caused him and his faction to break off and find refuge within Shattrath City. They see Terokk as a false prophet that will lead their people to doom. They have embraced the Light.
Skettis Kaliri are kaliri found flying around Skettis in Terokkar Forest.

Skitterweb Tunnels is an area of Lower Blackrock Spire, and the domain of the Skitterweb spiders. It is ruled by Mother Smolderweb, who contiously lays eggs to expand the population of her brood. Skitterweb Tunnels is spread over two levels leading via ramps and rubble from the lower reaches of Hordemar City up towards Urok Doomhowl's ledge.
Sketh'lon Commander's Journal - Page 1 drops from Dark Conclave Hawkeyes, Dark Conclave Ravenguards and Dark Conclave Shadowmancers in Shadowmoon Valley.
Sketh'lon Commander's Journal - Page 2 drops from Dark Conclave Hawkeyes, Dark Conclave Ravenguards and Dark Conclave Shadowmancers in Shadowmoon Valley.
Sketh'lon Commander's Journal - Page 3 drops from Dark Conclave Hawkeyes, Dark Conclave Ravenguards and Dark Conclave Shadowmancers in Shadowmoon Valley.
__NOTOC__ Skullcrusher the Mountain is a named gronn appearing in the Twilight Highlands. He was personally chosen by Cho'gall.
__NOTOC__ Skull Banner is a warrior ability, available at level 87.
Skizzle Slickslide is a goblin flight master located at K3 in the Storm Peaks.
The Skittering Riverbug can be found in the city of Suramar.
Skinny Milk is sold by Kurd Butterhoof in Highmountain for .
__NOTOC__ Skullhat is a kobold vignette and the apparent leader of the Skywhisker, found inside a cave in the Haglands in Highmountain along with three Skywhisker Scrappers.
Skrox is a pterrordax located at the Screaming Reaches in Un'Goro Crater. During his encounter he will fly in multiple different locations.

Skrog Wavecrashers are sea giants located in the instanced and uninstanced versions of the Eye of Azshara. The Court of Farondis and the Wardens want them killed, with Sira Moonwarden enlisting adventurers to kill them along with Saltscale Lurkers.
Skittish Squirrels are squirrels located in Drustvar. They are also found during Island Expeditions.

Techniques in skinning are listed under Skinning skills. In general, the ability to skin mobs is automatically gained when new proficiencies are learnt. Techniques are passively applied bonuses that provide more or different resources when looting the specific mob. When available, each mob has three ranks of proficiency.
Skeleton Pinkie is a passive racial ability for all mechagnomes, allowing you to use Lockpicking the same as any Rogue.
Skettis Surgers are water elementals located primarily in Blackwind Lake in Terokkar Forest. They can also be found up through Blackwind Valley and Skethyl Mountains, following along the river.
Skull Toss is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Skitterwing is a ravager wasp located in Island Expeditions.

__NOTOC__ Skuld is a Mawsworn kyrian located in the Fracture Chambers in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. He was found draining anima from three Bound Souls before Shandris Feathermoon and the Maw Walker arrived at the scene.
Skull Bloomer is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Skitterflies are skitterfly critters located on the Dragon Isles.
Skitterfly Riding becomes available after reaching Renown 25 with the Dragonscale Expedition.
The Skullsplitter Coin is a Paragon of Power sought after by the Zandalar Tribe.
Skymane Gorillas are gorillas native to Jaguero Island in the Cape of Stranglethorn. They are led by the Skymane King Mukla.
__NOTOC__ Skymistress Gloaming is the blood elf flight master located at west of the Shepherd's Gate in Eversong Woods.
__NOTOC__ Skymaster Sunwing is the blood elf flight master located at Tranquillien in the Ghostlands. When the Scourge attacked the town, Sunwing helped defend it.

.]] The Skyguard is an Alliance gunship that took part in the battle for the Seething Shore. The vessel, under the command of Grand Marshal Tremblade, was sent to the small island with a force of champions to recover the newly-formed :Azerite deposits present. During this mission, the Skyguard clashed with Horde forces based from their own gunship seeking the same resource. Master Mathias Shaw would oversee the Alliance's collection efforts from above, based from the Skyguard. Additionally, it was on this airship that the heroes of the orders drew the corruption out of the Sword of Sargeras.

Skullsplitter Fetish is a quest item only lootable by players on the quest Troll Witchery. Brother Nimetz believes these instruments of troll magic may hold the secret behind Colonel Kurzen's corruption.

Skullsplitter Witch Doctors are members of the Skullsplitter tribe. These vicious jungle trolls are spell casters who attack from afar. They sometimes use strange instruments of magic called Skullsplitter Fetishes. They also wear Split Bone Necklaces, like most of their tribe. Their strong Skullsplitter Tusks are much sought after by the merchants of Booty Bay as imitation tiger fangs.

Skullsplitter Mystics are jungle trolls located in Northern Stranglethorn. Members of the Skullsplitter tribe, these vicious trolls are spell casters who attack from afar. They sometimes use strange instruments of magic called Skullsplitter Fetishes. They also wear Split Bone Necklaces, like most of their tribe. Their strong Skullsplitter Tusks are much sought after by the merchants of Booty Bay as imitation tiger fangs.

Skunks are mammals that can be found across Azeroth and Outland. They are commonly found in Terokkar Forest, Azuremyst Isle, and Bloodmyst Isle, but can also be found in the Howling Fjord; more specifically, the Isle of Spears. Skunks are known as solitary creatures for reasons which are hopefully obvious. The ferocious highlands skunk can spray an attacker from thirty yards away, temporarily blinding them. The mountain skunk is most famous for its adventurous nature. No really, that is what it is famous for. Patch 10.2 introduced another model for skunks that can be found in the Emerald Dream. So far, only Henri Snufftail can be tamed by hunters. They are commonly received as being adorable
Sky-engines were a type of flying machine built by the gnomes before the First War. Both sky-engines and whirligigs were considered suitable for scouting.
